title: recommendation-service error-rate SLO burn
description: Elevated latency on recommendation-service (p95 582ms) with rising errors reported by consumers.
root_cause_detail: Event listeners registered per request in recommendation-service v2.5.0 were never removed.
expected_symptoms: recommendation-service memory_usage climbs gradually from ~48% to ~98% over ~67+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on recommendation-service
recommendation-service p95 latency rises from ~91ms to ~582ms as memory grows
recommendation-service errors appear late, error rate up to ~12.5%
recommendation-service db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
deployment of recommendation-service v2.5.0 shortly before memory growth starts
resolution: Rolled back recommendation-service to v2.4.11 and fixed listener deregistration.
